name: Enraged Polar Bear Spirit
description: The ghostly spirit of a polar bear stands on its hind legs and roars.
disable: DC 26 Nature (expert) to calm the spirit, DC 30 Intimidate (master) to cow the spirit, or DC 30 Religion (expert) to contain the spiritual corruption (each successful check reduces its number of actions by 1)
reset: The bear spirit calms after no creatures are in the room for 1 minute but is ready to lash out again after 10 minutes.
routine: (3 actions) The bear moves around the room at an alarming speed, seemingly teleporting, and Strikes a random creature with its spiritual claws.

defensiveAbilities.name: Feral Roar
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the polar bear spirit

Effect The polar bear spirit roars. Each creature in the room must attempt a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save. The enraged polar bear spirit rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature takes 6d6 Sonic Damage damage and is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature takes 12d6 Sonic Damage damage and is Frightened 3.
